answer: No, it is not free when a polyp is removed. If your provider finds and removes a polyp or other tissue during the colonoscopy, you pay 15% of the Medicare-approved amount for your provider's services, plus a 15% coinsurance to the facility in a hospital outpatient setting or ambulatory surgical center; the Part B deductible doesn't apply.
